$comment: The guides published from docs/guides/, in sidebar order. Each slug is a basename (without .md) and becomes the route /<slug>. Read by src/lib/guides.ts and scripts/check-links.mjs. sidebarTitles overrides a page's sidebar label (its H1 title otherwise); keep it short enough for one sidebar line, in sentence case except for domain terms such as Host. The GuideCard links in content/index.mdx take their titles and icons from here. icons names the Lucide icon (https://lucide.dev/icons, PascalCase) shown beside each page in the sidebar; every page needs one.
